newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica's Fedecoop hit by coffee warehouse fire.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica's Fedecoop hit by coffee warehouse fire.

text.p: A fire destroyed an unquantified amount of coffee and damaged the warehouse where it was stored, a spokesman for Costa Rican Fedecoop (Federacion de Cooperativas de Caficultores) said on Monday.

"The fire broke out late Friday in the warehouse of the dry production centre of San Joaquin de Flores (around 12 miles (20 km) northeast of San Jose)," Luis Diego Sanchez, Fedecoop manager told Reuters.

"Although we have not been able to quantify the damage, neither the buildings nor the amount of coffee destroyed, we can say that the coffee losses are much less than the 50,000 bags being talked about," Sanchez said.

Fedecoop staff are currently assessing damage. Insurance agents and fire experts are also trying to determine the cause of the blaze, which has temporarily stopped routine work at the production centre down, Sanchez added.
Costa Rica ended its 1996-1997 harvest in March with a crop of 2.7 million 60-kg bags, similar to the previous cycle.
